journal_lines: A man with two llamas. Offered something wrapped in cloth. Gave him a ration. He seemed satisfied.
Wandering trader on the road. Swapped a meal for something wrapped. Fair enough.
Strange merchant. His stock made no sense. Traded anyway. No regrets.
The trader spoke only to the llamas. The llamas seemed to translate. Took the deal anyway.
He had a bell on his belt that rang in no wind. Did not ask. Bought what he was selling.
An old man, very tired, very far from any road. The trade was as fair as he was tired.
Gave him most of my food. He gave me something I did not understand but knew was good.
Met him at a crossroads that had only one road. Did not question.
